verdict.rationale: Ramp documents real-time coding at the moment of spend. On swipe it captures the receipt and fills in memos and categories, and receipts are 'coded to the correct GL account' and auto-approved within policy. It reminds users about missing items and syncs accounting fields and transactions to QuickBooks in real time with a built-in reconciliation tool. The CLI and MCP also expose missing-receipt/memo detection and memo suggestions, so close becomes a review of exceptions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-coding accuracy, and in-depth first-party docs on how merchant/category/GL rules are configured (the evidence is mostly marketing-page claims).
